blocks.zh: GSPRs 第二部分 — 附加元件、設計與製造適用性、不適用之 GSPRs
blocks.en: GSPRs Part 2 — Add-on Components, Applicability of Design and Manufacture Requirements, and Nonapplicable GSPRs

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Chapter I（風險管理）對藥廠及元件供應商的要求，以及如何利用 ISO 14971 與 ICH Q9 建立風險管理檔案
blocks.en: Understand what Chapter I (risk management) requires of drug manufacturers and component suppliers, and how to use ISO 14971 and ICH Q9 to build a risk management file

blocks.zh: 掌握柱塞桿 (Plunger Rod)、硬針蓋剛性部分 (Rigid Part of RNS) 及指環延伸/擋板 (Finger Flange Extension/Backstop) 的 GSPR 文件要求 (Table 5.3-1)
blocks.en: Understand the GSPR documentation expected for the plunger rod, the rigid part of the rigid needle shield (RNS), and the finger flange extension/backstop (Table 5.3-1)

blocks.zh: 了解 GSPRs 10、11、13、14、15 對預填充注射器設計與製造的適用性概覽 (Section 5.4)
blocks.en: Get an overview of how GSPRs 10, 11, 13, 14 and 15 apply to the design and manufacture of prefilled syringes (Section 5.4)

blocks.zh: 學會撰寫不適用 GSPR 的理由說明 (Justification of Nonapplicability)，並掌握 Table 5.5-1🔍 中的範例措辭
blocks.en: Learn to write a justification of nonapplicability for a GSPR, and become familiar with the example wording in Table 5.5-1🔍

blocks.zh: 5.2 Chapter I — Risk Management 5.2 第 I 章 — 風險管理
blocks.en: 5.2 Chapter I — Risk Management

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Risk Management File (風險管理檔案)：這不是一份單一文件，而是一個「文件指標系統」。ISO 14971 明確允許風險管理檔案以參考/指引 (references or pointers) 的方式指向其他文件。關鍵是要能在合理時間內彙整所有相關記錄。
blocks.en: Risk Management File: This is not a single document but a "system of document pointers". ISO 14971 expressly allows the risk management file to point to other documents by reference. What matters is that all relevant records can be assembled within a reasonable time.

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 vs ISO 14971：兩者都是風險管理標準，但出發點不同。ICH Q9 從藥品品質的角度出發，ISO 14971 從醫療器材安全的角度出發。對於 DDC（藥物-器材組合產品），兩者都需要被參考。
blocks.en: ICH Q9 vs ISO 14971: Both are risk management standards, but they start from different places. ICH Q9 takes the perspective of drug product quality, while ISO 14971 takes the perspective of medical device safety. For a DDC (drug-device combination product), both need to be referenced.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像風險管理檔案就像一本「安全檢查手冊的總目錄」。這本目錄本身不需要包含每張檢查表的原件，但它必須清楚標明「消防檢查報告在 A 櫃第 3 層」、「電氣安全報告在 B 系統中」。稽核員來的時候，你要能快速從目錄找到並調出每一份報告。
blocks.en: Think of the risk management file as the master index of a safety inspection binder. The index itself does not need to hold the original of every checklist, but it must state clearly that "the fire inspection report is on shelf 3 of cabinet A" and "the electrical safety report is in system B". When an auditor arrives, you should be able to find each report from the index and pull it up quickly.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 本段最後一句話至關重要：最終責任永遠在藥廠身上。即使元件供應商提供了完整的風險評估文件，藥廠仍需自行判斷這些文件是否足夠、是否適用於自身的產品組合。供應商文件是「輔助性」的，不能取代藥廠自身的風險管理流程。
blocks.en: The last sentence of this section is critical: final responsibility always rests with the drug manufacturer. Even if the component supplier provides complete risk assessment documents, the drug manufacturer must still judge for itself whether they are sufficient and whether they apply to its own product combination. Supplier documents are supporting material and cannot replace the drug manufacturer's own risk management process.

blocks.zh: 此外，ISO/TR 24971 特別為那些在設計階段未使用 ISO 14971 的元件提供了風險管理檔案建立指引，這對歷史遺留 (legacy) 元件尤其重要。
blocks.en: In addition, ISO/TR 24971 gives guidance on building a risk management file for components that were not designed under ISO 14971, which is particularly important for legacy components.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果你是 PFS 元件供應商，你會如何向藥廠展示你的風險管理流程？需要分享哪些文件？
blocks.en: If you were a PFS component supplier, how would you demonstrate your risk management process to a drug manufacturer? Which documents would you need to share?

blocks.zh: 一家藥廠使用的注射器元件在設計時未採用 ISO 14971。根據本段內容，該藥廠應如何建立風險管理檔案？
blocks.en: A drug manufacturer uses a syringe component that was not designed under ISO 14971. Based on this section, how should the manufacturer build the risk management file?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 MDR 規定藥廠可以同時參考 ICH Q9 和 ISO 14971？這兩個標準各自涵蓋了哪些面向？
blocks.en: Why does the MDR allow drug manufacturers to reference both ICH Q9 and ISO 14971? What aspects does each standard cover?

blocks.zh: 5.3 Plunger Rod, Rigid Part of the Rigid Needle Shield and Finger Flange Extension/Backstop 5.3 推桿、剛性針頭護套剛性部分及指板延伸 / 止擋
blocks.en: 5.3 Plunger Rod, Rigid Part of the Rigid Needle Shield and Finger Flange Extension/Backstop

blocks.zh: Plunger Rod (柱塞桿)：推動橡膠活塞（plunger stopper）的剛性桿件，通常為塑膠材質。雖然它不直接接觸藥液，但作為使用者操作的元件，仍需評估其材料安全性與機械性能。
blocks.en: Plunger Rod: The rigid rod, usually plastic, that pushes the plunger stopper. Although it does not directly contact the drug solution, it is operated by the user, so its material safety and mechanical performance still need to be evaluated.

blocks.zh: RNS Rigid Part (硬針蓋剛性部分)：Rigid Needle Shield（硬針蓋）中的塑膠外殼部分，與彈性體密封件共同保護針頭。此處僅討論剛性部分的文件需求。
blocks.en: RNS Rigid Part: The plastic outer shell of the rigid needle shield (RNS), which protects the needle together with the elastomeric sealing part. Only the documentation needs for the rigid part are discussed here.

blocks.zh: Finger Flange Extension/Backstop (指環延伸/擋板)：某些 PFS 設計中使用的附加元件，提供額外的握持支撐或防止過度推注。
blocks.en: Finger Flange Extension/Backstop: An add-on component used in some PFS designs to provide extra grip support or to prevent over-injection.

blocks.zh: 可以把這些元件想像成汽車的方向盤套、排檔桿頭和手煞車護套。它們不是引擎核心零件，但使用者每次操作都會接觸到，因此仍需確認材料安全（例如是否含有害物質）及功能性（例如是否會滑手）。雖然文件需求比「引擎」（注射器主體和活塞）少，但絕對不能忽略。
blocks.en: You can think of these components as the steering wheel cover, gear knob and handbrake grip of a car. They are not core engine parts, but the user touches them every time, so you still need to confirm material safety (for example, no harmful substances) and functionality (for example, that they do not slip in the hand). The documentation needs are lighter than for the "engine" (syringe barrel and plunger stopper), but they must never be ignored.

blocks.zh: 生物相容性測試系列 (ISO 10993)：Table 5.3-1 列出了五項 ISO 10993 子標準。注意這些元件雖然不直接接觸藥液，但可能間接接觸（如柱塞桿推動活塞），因此需要進行細胞毒性 (Cytotoxicity)、致敏性 (Sensitization) 和刺激性 (Irritation) 評估。
blocks.en: Biocompatibility test series (ISO 10993): Table 5.3-1 lists five ISO 10993 parts. Note that although these components do not directly contact the drug solution, they may contact it indirectly (for example, the plunger rod pushing the stopper), so cytotoxicity, sensitization and irritation need to be evaluated.

blocks.zh: 關注物質聲明：供應商需要提供關於鄰苯二甲酸酯 (Phthalates)、CMR/ED 物質、REACH 高度關注物質 (SVHC)、元素分析 (ICH Q3D)、乳膠 (Latex) 和動物源材料 (TSE/BSE) 的使用/含量聲明。這是一份全面的排除清單。
blocks.en: Statements on substances of concern: The supplier must provide statements on the use/content of phthalates, CMR/ED substances, REACH substances of very high concern (SVHC), elemental impurities (ICH Q3D), latex, and animal-derived materials (TSE/BSE). This is a comprehensive exclusion list.

blocks.zh: Connectivity Statement (連接性聲明)：例如「螺紋部件適用於 17 pitch/25.4 mm 的 1 mL 長柱塞」。這確保了不同供應商的元件之間具有互換性。
blocks.en: Connectivity Statement: For example, "the threaded part is suitable for a 1 mL long plunger with 17 pitch/25.4 mm". This ensures interchangeability between components from different suppliers.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 作為藥廠 CMC 負責人，你在建立 DDC 送件檔案時，容易忽略柱塞桿等「非關鍵」元件的文件。實務上建議：
blocks.en: As the CMC lead at a drug manufacturer building a DDC submission dossier, it is easy to overlook the documentation for "non-critical" components such as the plunger rod. In practice, we recommend:

blocks.zh: 在供應商評鑑階段就要求提供 Table 5.3-1 中所有文件
blocks.en: Request all the documents in Table 5.3-1 already at the supplier qualification stage

blocks.zh: 將這些文件納入供應商品質協議 (Quality Agreement) 的附件清單
blocks.en: Include these documents in the list of appendices to the supplier Quality Agreement

blocks.zh: 定期更新，特別是在供應商變更原料或製程時
blocks.en: Update them periodically, especially when the supplier changes raw materials or processes

blocks.zh: 為什麼柱塞桿雖然不直接接觸藥液，仍需要進行 ISO 10993 生物相容性評估？
blocks.en: Why does a plunger rod still need an ISO 10993 biocompatibility evaluation even though it does not directly contact the drug solution?

blocks.zh: Connectivity Statement 對於確保 PFS 系統可靠性有何重要性？如果缺少此聲明可能導致什麼問題？
blocks.en: How important is the Connectivity Statement for ensuring PFS system reliability? What problems could arise if it is missing?

blocks.zh: Table 5.3-1 中列出的「Materials of concern」清單涵蓋了哪些法規面向？請嘗試將每項對應到具體的歐盟法規。
blocks.en: Which regulatory areas does the "Materials of concern" list in Table 5.3-1 cover? Try to map each item to a specific EU regulation.

blocks.zh: 5.4 Applicability of Requirements regarding Design and Manufacture 5.4 設計與製造相關需求之適用性
blocks.en: 5.4 Applicability of Requirements regarding Design and Manufacture

blocks.zh: GSPRs 10, 11, 13, 14, 15 的涵蓋範圍：
blocks.en: Scope of GSPRs 10, 11, 13, 14 and 15:

blocks.zh: GSPR 10：化學、物理和生物學特性 — 材料選擇與控制
blocks.en: GSPR 10: Chemical, physical and biological properties — material selection and control

blocks.zh: GSPR 11：感染與微生物污染 — 無菌製造與微生物控制
blocks.en: GSPR 11: Infection and microbial contamination — sterile manufacturing and microbial control

blocks.zh: GSPR 13：含生物源材料的器材 — 動物源/人源材料安全
blocks.en: GSPR 13: Devices incorporating materials of biological origin — safety of animal-/human-derived materials

blocks.zh: GSPR 14：一般設計與製造要求 — 設計開發、風險管理、可用性工程
blocks.en: GSPR 14: General design and manufacturing requirements — design and development, risk management, usability engineering

blocks.zh: GSPR 15：防護特性 — 與其他器材和物質的相互作用
blocks.en: GSPR 15: Protective properties — interaction with other devices and substances

blocks.zh: Holistic Control Strategy (整體控制策略)：這不是逐項勾選的合規清單，而是將材料控制、設計開發和製程管理整合為一個有機的品質保證體系。
blocks.en: Holistic Control Strategy: This is not an item-by-item compliance checklist, but a quality assurance system that integrates material control, design and development, and process management into one coherent whole.

blocks.zh: Figure 5.4-1🔍 就像是一張「建築工程品質管控地圖」。蓋一棟大樓需要管控的不只是鋼筋水泥的品質（材料控制 = GSPR 10/13），還包括設計圖是否合理（設計開發 = GSPR 14）、施工過程是否規範（製程控制 = GSPR 11/15），以及最終建築能否承受地震（性能驗證）。這五項 GSPR 涵蓋了從原料進場到成品出廠的完整品質鏈。
blocks.en: Figure 5.4-1🔍 is like a "quality control map for a building project". Constructing a building requires controlling not only the quality of the steel and cement (material control = GSPR 10/13), but also whether the design drawings are sound (design and development = GSPR 14), whether the construction process is well regulated (process control = GSPR 11/15), and whether the finished building can withstand an earthquake (performance verification). These five GSPRs cover the complete quality chain from incoming raw materials to the released finished product.

blocks.zh: 本段的關鍵訊息是：適用性評估必須針對目標產品概況 (Target Product Profile, TPP) 進行。不同的 PFS 產品（例如生物製劑 vs 小分子藥物、帶安全裝置 vs 不帶安全裝置）可能導致不同的 GSPR 子要求適用。
blocks.en: The key message of this section is: the applicability assessment must be made against the Target Product Profile (TPP). Different PFS products (for example, biologics vs small molecules, with vs without a safety device) may trigger different GSPR sub-requirements.

blocks.zh: 例如，一支用於腫瘤科的預填充注射器可能需要特別關注 GSPR 10（化學交互作用與可萃取/可溶出物）和 GSPR 14（可用性工程，因為患者可能自行注射），而一支僅供醫療專業人員使用的產品可能在 GSPR 22（非專業人員使用）上被列為不適用。
blocks.en: For example, a prefilled syringe for oncology may need particular attention to GSPR 10 (chemical interactions and extractables/leachables) and GSPR 14 (usability engineering, since patients may self-inject), whereas a product used only by healthcare professionals may be judged not applicable for GSPR 22 (use by lay persons).

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR73-2 建議針對 Target Product Profile 進行 GSPR 適用性詳細評估？不同的 TPP 會如何影響評估結果？
blocks.en: Why does TR73-2 recommend a detailed GSPR applicability assessment against the Target Product Profile? How would different TPPs affect the outcome of the assessment?

blocks.zh: GSPRs 10-15 涵蓋了「材料-設計-製程」三個面向。請嘗試繪製一張簡單的概念圖，展示這三個面向如何相互關聯。
blocks.en: GSPRs 10-15 cover the three dimensions of materials, design and process. Try drawing a simple concept diagram showing how these three dimensions relate to each other.

blocks.zh: 5.5 Nonapplicable GSPRs and Their Justifications 5.5 不適用之 GSPR 及其論證
blocks.en: 5.5 Nonapplicable GSPRs and Their Justifications

blocks.zh: Justification of Nonapplicability (不適用理由說明)：在 MDR 合規文件中，「不適用」不代表可以忽略。每一項被判定為不適用的 GSPR 都需要一段書面理由，解釋為什麼該要求不適用於你的產品。這是法規審查的重要組成部分。
blocks.en: Justification of Nonapplicability: In MDR compliance documentation, "not applicable" does not mean "can be ignored". Every GSPR judged not applicable needs a written justification explaining why the requirement does not apply to your product. This is an important part of regulatory review.

blocks.zh: TR73-2 提出了三項撰寫原則：
blocks.en: TR73-2 proposes three principles for writing justifications:

blocks.zh: 逐條論證 (Granularity)：如果一項 GSPR 包含多個子要求，必須逐一說明哪些不適用
blocks.en: Granularity: If a GSPR contains several sub-requirements, state for each one which do not apply

blocks.zh: 用語一致 (Alignment)：使用與 GSPR 原文相同的術語
blocks.en: Alignment: Use the same terminology as the GSPR text

blocks.zh: 精確簡潔 (Precision)：不要長篇大論，直接點出不適用的邏輯
blocks.en: Precision: Do not write at length; state the logic of nonapplicability directly

blocks.zh: 想像你在申請建築許可證。許可證表格上有一項「消防灑水系統設計圖」。如果你蓋的是一座露天涼亭，你不能直接留空不填，而要寫上：「本建築為露天結構，無封閉空間，不適用室內消防灑水系統要求」。審查官看到這段文字就知道你已經考慮過這項要求，並且有合理理由不適用。MDR 的不適用理由撰寫就是同樣的邏輯。
blocks.en: Imagine applying for a building permit. The form has an item for "fire sprinkler system drawings". If you are building an open-air pavilion, you cannot simply leave it blank; you write, "This building is an open-air structure with no enclosed space, so the indoor fire sprinkler requirements do not apply." When the reviewer reads this, they know you have considered the requirement and have a reasonable basis for it not applying. Writing a justification of nonapplicability under the MDR follows the same logic.

blocks.zh: Table 5.5-1🔍 的典型排除類別：
blocks.en: Typical exclusion categories in Table 5.5-1🔍:

blocks.zh: 非主動式器材 (Passive Device)：PFS 不含電子元件、不發射輻射、不主動供應能量，因此 GSPR 16-18、20.6、21 系列都不適用
blocks.en: Passive device: A PFS contains no electronic components, emits no radiation and does not actively supply energy, so the GSPR 16-18, 20.6 and 21 series do not apply

blocks.zh: 非 Annex XVI 產品：GSPR 9 僅適用於無醫療目的的產品（如美容填充物），PFS 作為給藥器材不在此範圍內
blocks.en: Not an Annex XVI product: GSPR 9 applies only to products without a medical purpose (such as aesthetic fillers); a PFS, as a drug delivery device, is outside this scope

blocks.zh: 標籤法規優先級：GSPR 23 的器材標籤要求被 EMA/37991/2019（藥品標籤指引）取代。這反映了 DDC 的雙重身份——作為藥品的法規要求優先於器材標籤要求
blocks.en: Labeling regulation takes precedence: The device labeling requirements of GSPR 23 are superseded by EMA/37991/2019 (guideline on labeling of medicinal products). This reflects the dual identity of a DDC: its regulatory requirements as a medicinal product take precedence over device labeling requirements

blocks.zh: GSPR 21.1 的「一支一劑」邏輯：PFS 沒有劑量設定功能，因為一支預填充注射器就是一個劑量，這是最簡潔有力的不適用理由
blocks.en: The "one syringe, one dose" logic of GSPR 21.1: A PFS has no dose-setting function because one prefilled syringe is one dose; this is the simplest and most compelling justification of nonapplicability

blocks.zh: 在準備 MDR 合規文件時，建議建立一份「GSPR 適用性矩陣」：
blocks.en: When preparing MDR compliance documentation, we recommend building a "GSPR applicability matrix":

blocks.zh: 第一欄：GSPR 編號（1-23，含所有子條款）
blocks.en: Column 1: GSPR number (1-23, including all sub-clauses)

blocks.zh: 第二欄：適用/不適用/部分適用
blocks.en: Column 2: Applicable / Not applicable / Partially applicable

blocks.zh: 第三欄：理由說明（不適用時填寫）或對應文件索引（適用時填寫）
blocks.en: Column 3: Justification (when not applicable) or index of the corresponding documents (when applicable)

blocks.zh: 第四欄：責任方（藥廠/供應商/共同負責）
blocks.en: Column 4: Responsible party (drug manufacturer / supplier / shared)

blocks.zh: 這份矩陣可以直接作為 Technical Documentation 中 GSPR checklist 的基礎文件。
blocks.en: This matrix can serve directly as the basis for the GSPR checklist in the Technical Documentation.

blocks.zh: 腳註解讀 Footnote Analysis
blocks.en: Footnote Analysis

blocks.zh: 腳註 1 揭示了一個重要的法規分界：PFS 的即時標籤 (Immediate Labeling) 受藥品法規 Directive 2001/83/EC 管轄，而非 MDR。但器材設計開發過程中產生的安全與性能資訊仍應反映在使用者相關的標籤內容中。
blocks.en: Footnote 1 reveals an important regulatory boundary: the immediate labeling of a PFS falls under the medicinal product legislation, Directive 2001/83/EC, not the MDR. However, safety and performance information generated during device design and development should still be reflected in the user-facing labeling content.

blocks.zh: 腳註 2 則說明：雖然 PFS 器材本身沒有控制器或指示器，但使用前的目視檢查 (Visual Inspection) 要求會在使用說明書 (IFU) 中規定，並在向主管機關 (CAs) 的申請文件中提供。
blocks.en: Footnote 2 explains that although the PFS device itself has no controls or indicators, the requirement for visual inspection before use is specified in the instructions for use (IFU) and provided in the application dossier submitted to the competent authorities (CAs).

blocks.zh: 如果你的 PFS 產品配備了電子式自動注射裝置 (Autoinjector)，Table 5.5-1🔍 中哪些「不適用」的 GSPR 會變成「適用」？請列舉並說明原因。
blocks.en: If your PFS product is fitted with an electronic autoinjector, which "not applicable" GSPRs in Table 5.5-1🔍 would become "applicable"? List them and explain why.

blocks.zh: GSPR 23 的不適用理由提到了 EMA/37991/2019。為什麼藥品標籤法規會「覆蓋」器材標籤法規？這與 DDC 的法規定位有什麼關係？
blocks.en: The justification for GSPR 23 mentions EMA/37991/2019. Why does medicinal product labeling legislation "override" device labeling requirements? How does this relate to the regulatory position of a DDC?

blocks.zh: 嘗試為以下假設情境撰寫不適用理由：你的 PFS 產品需要評估 GSPR 19（Protection against the risks posed by devices intended by the manufacturer for use by lay persons）。如果你的產品僅限醫療專業人員使用，你會如何撰寫理由？
blocks.en: Try writing a justification of nonapplicability for the following hypothetical scenario: your PFS product needs to be assessed against GSPR 19 (Protection against the risks posed by devices intended by the manufacturer for use by lay persons). If your product is restricted to use by healthcare professionals, how would you write the justification?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 風險管理 (Section 5.2)：MDR Chapter I 要求藥廠建立內部風險管理流程。風險管理檔案可以是指標式文件系統（不需實體包含所有記錄），但必須能在合理時間內彙整。元件供應商可提供輔助文件，但最終責任在藥廠。參考標準包括 ICH Q9 與 ISO 14971。
blocks.en: Risk management (Section 5.2): MDR Chapter I requires the drug manufacturer to establish an internal risk management process. The risk management file can be a pointer-based document system (it need not physically contain all records), but it must be possible to assemble the records within a reasonable time. Component suppliers can provide supporting documents, but final responsibility rests with the drug manufacturer. Reference standards include ICH Q9 and ISO 14971.

blocks.zh: 附加元件文件需求 (Section 5.3)：柱塞桿、RNS 剛性部分和指環延伸/擋板雖然 GSPR 要求較少，但仍需評估材料安全（生物相容性、關注物質聲明）與技術性能（圖紙、連接性聲明、物理特性）。供應商應提供合規證書、數據表和測試報告作為支持文件。
blocks.en: Documentation needs for add-on components (Section 5.3): Although the GSPR requirements for the plunger rod, the RNS rigid part and the finger flange extension/backstop are lighter, material safety (biocompatibility, statements on substances of concern) and technical performance (drawings, connectivity statement, physical properties) still need to be evaluated. Suppliers should provide certificates of compliance, data sheets and test reports as supporting documents.

blocks.zh: 設計與製造適用性 (Section 5.4)：GSPRs 10、11、13、14 和 15 涵蓋了材料控制、設計開發與製程管理的完整範圍。應針對目標產品概況 (TPP) 進行詳細的適用性評估，以建立整體控制策略。
blocks.en: Applicability of design and manufacture requirements (Section 5.4): GSPRs 10, 11, 13, 14 and 15 cover the full range of material control, design and development, and process management. A detailed applicability assessment should be made against the Target Product Profile (TPP) in order to establish a holistic control strategy.

blocks.zh: 不適用 GSPR 的理由撰寫 (Section 5.5)：被判定不適用的 GSPR 必須提供書面理由。撰寫原則：逐條論證、用語與 GSPR 原文一致、精確簡潔。典型排除理由包括 PFS 為非主動式器材（排除輻射、電子、能源相關要求）、標籤要求由藥品法規覆蓋、一支一劑無需劑量設定等。
blocks.en: Writing justifications for nonapplicable GSPRs (Section 5.5): A GSPR judged not applicable must have a written justification. The writing principles are granularity, wording aligned with the GSPR text, and precision with brevity. Typical grounds for exclusion include the PFS being a passive device (excluding radiation, electronics and energy-related requirements), labeling requirements being covered by medicinal product legislation, and one syringe being one dose so that no dose setting is needed.

blocks.zh: 實務建議：建立 GSPR 適用性矩陣作為 Technical Documentation 基礎文件，在供應商評鑑階段即要求提供所有必要的支持文件，並在品質協議中明確文件更新義務。
blocks.en: Practical recommendations: Build a GSPR applicability matrix as the base document of the Technical Documentation, require all necessary supporting documents already at the supplier qualification stage, and define document update obligations explicitly in the quality agreement.
